methodology_finding: Reconstructed 23,119 category-incompatible candidate pairs across 11 disjoint domain rules. Manual inspection of the 100-pair stratified sample confirms that the overwhelming majority denote coincidental spatial co-locations (e.g. Bank ATM adjacent to school, clinic near restaurant). While primary commercial identities are effectively preserved, potential subsidiary co-locations (e.g. hospital cafeteria, university branch) remain intentionally pruned under 1-to-1 conflation.
